title: Canada: a 25,000.00 journal (above the former 10,000.00 limit) posts at once; nothing waits for approval and the trial balance balances
A 50,000.00 vendor invoice is issued and posted at once (status open, not sent for approval)
A 20,000.00 customer invoice is voided directly: the preview needs no second owner and the void applies at once
A 15,000.00 customer credit note (refused above the former limit) is now posted
With limits switched on (test config), the journal, vendor invoice and void wait for approval; this proves the setting still works when an operator enables it
After the limits are removed, a journal that was already waiting is still approved by a second owner (its maker cannot) and posts
A vendor invoice that was already waiting is still approved by a second owner and posted by that approver
A void that was already waiting is still approved by a second owner (its maker cannot) and the invoice is voided
A bank unpost that was already waiting is still approved by a second owner (its maker cannot) and the line returns to Unposted
The setting is off again: a new 30,000.00 journal posts at once
